regime_claim.description: Actual counted-GMRES work grouped by decision-procedure verdict.

state_schedule_note: Each state is produced by the stable reference backward-Euler step size state_dt with the frozen_bulk preconditioner.  Each analysis_dt then defines a separate fixed linearized backward-Euler system at that genuinely visited state.

verdict_on_decision_procedure.description: Identity-preconditioned cost defines hard states; all D0 variants are then compared on the same state and candidate implicit step.
verdict_on_decision_procedure.hard_label: identity actual GMRES iterations >= median identity iterations
verdict_on_decision_procedure.summary: yes: the identity disk rate rises from easy to hard states and the investigate fraction does not fall.
